notes.title: Trading cards are now available for Toy Tinker Simulator
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are delighted to announce that Steam Trading Cards are now available on Steam, along with other exclusive rewards:

• Collect Trading cards by playing the game
• Win various badges
• Unlock backgrounds for your profile
• Use unique emoticons


Have fun!

TR Games

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510580/Toy_Tinker_Simulator/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1755300/Smart_Factory_Tycoon/
